# GitHub v1.4 — Public Data Copilot / Agent Instructions

**项目口令：`按 GitHub v1.4 执行。`**

Read first:

- `docs/github_execution_protocol_v1_4_public.md`
- `docs/long_running_engineering_execution_protocol.md`
- `reference/long_running_engineering_execution_contract_v2.json`

Public-data engineering may proceed autonomously inside frozen scope. Preserve PIT/no-lookahead, exact source identity, manifest/hash integrity and public/private security boundaries.

For long work, preflight and decompose before increasing timeout; preserve durable progress and immutable completed units; rerun only the smallest affected scope.

New workflows are manual-only unless explicitly authorized.

Never introduce private model semantics, thresholds, signals, holdings, private evidence, research results, secrets, Production authority or trading authority.
